Community center bundles and stuff is baked in your save file and messing with them mid-game (by adding of removing stuff) can break the fabric of the reality. It's totally safe to use it otherwise.

All Community Center Bundles
.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.
        Version : 2.0 - Compatible with SDV 1.6
Author : Lefkada
.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.
DESCRIPTION
This mod add all the regular and remixed bundles to the community center. Spirit's Eve & Winter Star bundles are not included due to bundles somehow limited at 9 per category.
This mod is meant to be used with the "normal" community center bundle option, not the "remixed" option.
HOW TO INSTALL
If you use the Content Patcher version:
Place this mod in your "Stardew Valley\Mods" folder.
Be sure to have Content Patcher.

If you are still using the old .xnb file version:
Replace the Bundles.xnb in the "Stardew Valley\Content\Data" folder.
Be sure to create a backup of the original file.

NOTABLE CHANGES
• Added Spring Onion as possible item to the Spring Foraging Bundle. Still needs 4 items to be completed.
• Added Carrot, Summer Squash and Broccoli as possible item to their respective seasonal Bundles. Still needs 4 items to be completed.
• Added Holly as possible item to the Winter Foraging Bundle. Still needs 4 items to be completed.
• Summer Foraging now needs Coral.
• Fish Farmer's Bundle was moved into the Fish Tank due to a display limit of 9 bundles.
• Bundles with multiple possible items required like Dye Bundle uses their normal non remixed version.
• Some rewards have been changed to avoid duplicate items. See the list below for more details.
KNOWNS BUGS
• Right after completing a bundle, if you hover the other bundles with your mouse cursor, their name won't display. 
• If you choose "remixed" community center bundle option, some bundles will be missing and others will appears twice. Just don't use "remixed" bundles.
